macros.name: breaklabel
macros.doc: causes the definition description to start on the line following the label if the width of the label exceeds the width of the left margin.

macros.name: compact
macros.doc: indicates that items should not be separated from each other by vertical white space.

macros.name: setlabelphantom
macros.doc: The \setlabelphantom command reserves the width of the argument as horizontal space for the label.

macros.name: setlabelstyle
macros.doc: The \setlabelstyle identifies the style to be used for labels.

macros.name: setleftmargin
macros.doc: gives the amount of horizontal space to be reserved for the left margin of the item, and defaults to the value of the original LaTeX-description list if not entered.

envs.name: description
envs.doc: The expanded description environment supports an easy possibility of changing the left margin in a desciption list.
